Layer 6 composition root for the ops/workspace BC. Hyper binary `oya-ops-workspace-shell` listens on 127.0.0.1:OYATIE_OPS_WORKSPACE_PORT (default 8080). Wires kernel → application → rest → router-kernel → middleware-kernel → runtime-hyper-adapter into a single tokio::main. Per ADR-0090.

Layer 4 middleware: per-request budget timer; replaces response with 504 when elapsed exceeds budget_ms. Std-only; sync (post-hoc enforcement).
Layer 4 middleware: per-(method, route, status_class) counter + total_latency_us aggregator. In-memory sink; OTel exporter is a separate slice.
